message: Hey everyone, just a reminder about the community potluck this Saturday at Brooksville Park!

Tom, I know you're worried about your immigration status, but we'll find a way to sort it out. You've been a hardworking member of our Brooksville community, contributing with your carpentry skills even without proper documentation. We're here to support you through your fear of deportation.

Does anyone need some carpentry work done? My brother Tom is incredibly skilled and looking for local opportunities. He's currently undocumented and fears deportation, but we're doing everything we can to help him stay because he's an important part of our community.
Good morning, Brooksville Residents! Don't forget to support our local businesses!
